note: Synthetic extraction fixtures. No personal or real customer data, and none may ever be added — see docs/RESUME_CHECKPOINT.md. Each case pairs a document with the response a provider would return for it, and pins down what the app makes of the pair. Several responses are deliberately wrong: fabricated deadlines, ungrounded consequences, injected instructions. What is being tested is the app's reaction, not the model's skill.
